issues.jp_before: 飛行機[ひこうき]に{乗[の]るなら|cd-nara}、早[はや]めに空港[くうこう]へ着[つ]いていてください。
issues.problem: 着いていてください is unnatural.
issues.action: Rewrote the ending to 空港に着くようにしてください and updated the English.

issues.jp_before: ケーキを{作[つく]るなら|cd-nara}、卵[たまご]を先[さき]に冷[ひ]やしておくといいよ。
issues.problem: Chilling eggs before baking a cake is odd advice.
issues.action: Changed it to taking the butter out of the fridge first and updated the English.

issues.jp_before: 駅[えき]まで{歩[ある]くなら|cd-nara}… / 本[ほん]を{読[よ]むなら|cd-nara}… / 部屋[へや]を{出[で]るなら|cd-nara}… / {寒[さむ]いなら/寒[さむ]かったら|cd-nara}…
issues.problem: lv 5 is too low because なら is N4 grammar.
issues.action: Set lv to 4 on these four items.

issues.jp_before: 人[ひと]にお金[かね]を{貸[か]すなら|cd-nara}、返[かえ]してもらう日[ひ]を決[き]めておくといいよ。
issues.problem: The distractor 貸したら is nearly acceptable (you can fix the date when you lend).
issues.action: Added 先に to the sentence and 'beforehand' to the English, so 〜たら is clearly wrong.

issues.jp_before: {行[い]きたくないなら/行[い]きたくなかったら|cd-nara}、無理[むり]に来[こ]なくてもいいよ。
issues.problem: The sentence mixes 行く and 来る in a mismatched way, and so does the English.
issues.action: Changed it to 無理に行かなくてもいいよ and the English to 'you don't have to'.

issues.jp_before: 来月[らいげつ]、北海道[ほっかいどう]へ行[い]こうと思[おも]っているんです。北海道[ほっかいどう]{なら/だったら|cd-nara}、六月[ろくがつ]ごろがいいですよ。
issues.problem: Recommending June to someone who goes next month is incoherent.
issues.action: Changed the advice to レンタカーが便利ですよ and updated the English.

issues.jp_before: ピアノを{習[なら]いたいなら|cd-nara}… / ここで{泳[およ]ぎたいなら|cd-nara}…
issues.problem: The equally natural たかったら alternative was missing, unlike the other たい items.
issues.action: Added 習いたかったら and 泳ぎたかったら as alternatives.

issues.jp_before: その店[みせ]に{行[い]くなら|cd-nara}、ついでに私[わたし]のパンも買[か]ってきて。
issues.problem: The distractor 行ったら is perfectly natural here, because the buying happens at the shop.
issues.action: Moved 行ったら to the alternatives, added the distractor 行っても, and rewrote the why.

issues.jp_before: 引[ひ]っ越[こ]しを{するなら|cd-nara}、今月[こんげつ]中[ちゅう]に連絡[れんらく]してください。
issues.problem: The distractor したら is natural (let us know after you move), and the sentence did not force a notice before the move.
issues.action: Changed it to 一か月前までに連絡してください, so the notice must come first, and updated the English.

issues.jp_before: 彼女[かのじょ]に{会[あ]うなら|cd-nara}、この手紙[てがみ]を渡[わた]してください。
issues.problem: The distractor 会ったら is perfectly natural (hand it over when you meet her).
issues.action: Rewrote the ending to この本を持っていってくれる？ (the book is taken before the meeting) and updated the English and why.

issues.jp_before: (8 items whose why was 'The other event comes first, so the speaker picks up the plan and gives advice about the preparation: なら.')
issues.problem: The why was vague and confusing.
issues.action: Replaced it with: The advice is about preparing before the planned action, so なら; 〜たら would put it after, and と or ば cannot lead into advice.
